```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Polar plot of a spiral: radius increasing linearly with angle over two full turns, with radial gridlines at 0.5, 1, 1.5, and 2."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01)
theta = 2 * np.pi * r
fig, ax = plt.subplots(subplot_kw={"projection": "polar"})
ax.plot(theta, r)
ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2])
ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
